memberdef.name: kFogModes
memberdef.initializer: = { FogTests::FOG_LINEAR, FogTests::FOG_EXP, FogTests::FOG_EXP2, FogTests::FOG_EXP_ABS, FogTests::FOG_EXP2_ABS, FogTests::FOG_LINEAR_ABS, }

detaileddescription.para: Constructs the test suite and creates test cases.

simplesect.para: CoordNotSet Tests behavior when the vertex shader does not write to the oFog register after prior draws, demonstrating carryover/residual fog coordinate state.
W-0.00_0.25_0.00_0.00 Sets oFog.w via shader to test that oFog.x receives the scalar fog value.
W_X-0.25_0.00_0.00_0.50 Sets oFog.w followed by oFog.x to verify that the last-set component takes precedence.
W_X-0.65_0.00_0.00_0.00 Sets oFog.w followed by oFog.x with input (0.65, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00).
W_Y-1.00_0.00_1.00_0.75 Sets oFog.w followed by oFog.y with input (1.00, 0.00, 1.00, 0.75).
W_Y-0.00_0.75_0.75_0.25 Sets oFog.w followed by oFog.y with input (0.00, 0.75, 0.75, 0.25).
W_Z_Y_X-0.25_0.50_0.75_1.00 Sets oFog.w, then z, then y, then x sequentially.
W_Z_Y_X-1.00_0.75_0.50_0.25 Sets oFog.w, then z, then y, then x sequentially with inverted values.
X_Y_Z_W-1.00_0.25_0.75_0.50 Sets oFog.x, then y, then z, then w sequentially.
X_Y_Z_W-0.00_0.33_0.66_0.90 Sets oFog.x, then y, then z, then w sequentially.
